question: What contemplative visualization grants the power to shake the triple world?
premises: One should always contemplate a smoke-colored form.
Such contemplation enables one to shake the triple world.
inference: Constant contemplation of a smoke-colored form yields the power to shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The specific object that is smoke-colored is not explicitly named.
plain_english: O beloved, always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
